checks.message: Provisional boundary is clearly disclosed and is not presented as an official redline or precise-area basis.
All three key areas remain provisional and retain announced-area versus calculated-area distinctions.
Land-use polygons form a complete, non-overlapping partition of the submitted provisional boundary.
The redesigned static HTML is responsive, offline, local-image-only and exposes required metric markers.
Proposal sections, figures, geometry, metrics, standards and depth items are connected by requirement-specific evidence mappings.
Alaya's lack of a physical body and the synthetic nature of personas, observations and scene events are explicitly disclosed.
A3 booklet contains 12 full-layout pages and A0 package contains 7 full-layout boards with readable provisional-status notes.
